rationale: The agent verified the user via email before accessing account/order details. It correctly retrieved and summarized recent orders, identified the fleece jacket in a pending order (#W2466703), and accurately stated that exchanges can only be processed after delivery, which aligns with policy that actions depend on order status. The agent did not perform any write without confirmation, offered the appropriate alternative (modify the pending order), and respected the constraint when the user chose to wait. No unsupported claims or actions on the wrong account occurred. While the exchange wasn’t completed due to order status, the agent handled the request properly within policy, hence a pass.
